title: Figure 4: Theoretical voltage spectral density of a tungsten coil
description: Log-log plot of S(f,T) in V^2/Hz versus frequency f (10^7 to 10^9 Hz), with a steeply rising blue curve and a shallower red line. An inset legend lists parameters: "Material: W", "N coil: 2000", "a coil: 1 cm", "b coil: 0.01 cm", "T: 3 Kelvin". Caption: "Figure 4. Theoretical Voltage Spectral Density of a Tungsten Coil."
